scope: Feasibility only. No Raman extinction/backscatter product is derived here.

repository_semantics.caveat: The repository identifies companion wavelengths but does not yet document enough species/filter/transmission semantics to derive a scientifically defensible Raman extinction constraint from MILGRAU alone.

interpretation: The current night instrument profile retains non-elastic companion channels with strong enough Level-1 signal to make an independent boundary-validation R&D path plausible at the altitudes relevant to P5.4.

Signal availability alone is not sufficient to call these channels a validated Raman retrieval. Species identity, filter/receiver spectral response, wavelength semantics, molecular cross-sections and any required aerosol-wavelength relationship must be documented first.
The 408 channels present in this Level-1 file are not part of the current 2024+ SCC night channel list, so their presence must not be silently interpreted as an active validated companion product.
decision: Prioritize Raman-companion spectral/instrument semantics as a physically independent route to boundary-condition validation. Keep it R&D until the required metadata and forward/retrieval physics are explicit and tested.
